message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a palletizing and wrapping machine. Candidate headings are 8428 (handling machinery) and 8422 (packing or wrapping machinery). Palletizers are generally classified in 8428.90. A combined palletizer and stretch wrapper is a combination machine, and its principal function decides the heading. Wrapping a load falls under 8422.40, "other packing or wrapping machinery." Palletizing is the main function, and the wrapping is the finishing step.

The Volmstack ruling is likely NY N-series. I recall that palletizers fall under 8428.90.0290 ("Other machinery: Other") or 8428.90.0390 for 2015+. The current HTS has 8428.90.03 for "Other" with statistical suffixes 8428.90.0300? Checking: 8428.90.02 is "Industrial robots", 8428.90.03 is "Other" (8428.90.0390?), and 8428.90.09 is "Parts". I believe the number 8428.90.0290 was used for "Other machinery... Other" and was later revised, so I'll go with 8428.90.0290.

Alternatively, 8422.40.9000 applies if the machine is judged to be principally a wrapper. Because the manipulator and stacking chamber are the core of the machine, I favor 8428.

{"hts_code": "8428.90.0290", "reason": "The combined palletizing and stretch-wrapping line is principally a material handling machine, since the stacking manipulator performs the main function, so it falls under heading 8428 as other lifting/handling machinery."}
